name: What is the difference between general home repair and remodeling?
description: Repair restores existing components to original function. Remodeling changes a space's structure, function, or aesthetics.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between general home repair and remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: General home repair focuses on restoring existing components or systems to their original, functional condition after damage, wear, or malfunction. This includes fixing a leaky pipe, repairing a damaged roof, or patching drywall. Remodeling, on the other hand, involves changing the structure, function, or aesthetics of a space, such as updating a kitchen, adding a room, or reconfiguring a bathroom layout. While both improve a home, repairs address existing problems, whereas remodeling creates new features or modernizes spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair restores existing components to original function. Remodeling changes a space's structure, function, or aesthetics.
